notes.title: Patch Notes for 13/07/2024
notes.notes:
Added:

New Game mode: Capture The Flag 
Stand on the flag base, Press E. Take to your base and Press E to capture it. Simple!
Confirmation on quitting/Back to main menu


Changed:

Leader board text changed - RED/BLUE TEAM | TEAM SCORE to BLUE/RED TEAM
Main Menu - Discord Icon moved




Fixed:

Game session not destroying when client time-out from match/host crashing/force quitting.

notes.title: Combat Evolved 2D: Official Release
notes.notes:
CE2D is now live

Welcome to Combat Evolved 2D! A 2D Top Down PvP game, great to play with your friends or randoms!

Servers use Steams Relay to protect servers and players from dos attacks since IP addresses are never revealed. 

Greetings!

Thank you for joining us on this journey and project. Your support for the game means a lot and will to continue to help us shape the game.


Reminder:
Though the base game is officially released, it does mean it's still actively being developed and refined. We are continuously working to improve your gaming experience, and we greatly appreciate your patience and understanding during this phase.


We Need Your Feedback!
Your feedback is invaluable in helping us shape the future of the game. If you encounter any bugs, issues, or have suggestions for improvement, please let us know! You can share your thoughts and reports in the Steam Discussions or join our community on Discord.
